name: Exp_BSI
summary: This EA trades based on the BSI (Buy Sell Indicator) custom indicator signals. It opens buy positions when the BSI signals bullish momentum (value transitions to 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (value transitions to 0), with optional position closing on opposite signals. Money management is configurable via multiple margin modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BSI（买卖指标）自定义指标的信号进行交易。当BSI发出看涨动量信号（值转为2）时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号（值转为0）时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。资金管理支持多种保证金模式，包括固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于BSI指标的动量方向信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件：当BSI指标缓冲区3的值从非2变为2时，产生做多信号；当值从非0变为0时，产生做空信号。出场条件：当出现反向信号时，可通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose参数控制是否平掉相反方向仓位，同时设置了固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode参数控制，支持按可用保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后的保证金/余额比例以及固定手数四种模式。策略使用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。指标参数包括Range Period（20）、Slowing（3）、Avg Period（3）以及成交量权重选择，通过平滑和平均处理减少假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA follows momentum direction signals generated by the BSI custom indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when BSI indicator buffer 3 transitions from a non-2 value to 2, and a sell signal is triggered when it transitions from a non-0 value to 0. Exit conditions: opposite signals can close existing positions if BuyPosClose and SellPosClose are enabled, while fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) provide additional exit mechanisms. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter and MMMode enum, supporting four modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin percentage, loss-adjusted balance percentage, and fixed lot size. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar) to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trade entries. Indicator parameters include Range Period (20), Slowing (3), Avg Period (3), and volume weight selection, with smoothing and averaging applied to reduce false signals.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 保证金模式：可用保证金/余额/扣除亏损后保证金/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Position sizing mode: Free margin/Balance/Net margin/Net balance/Fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否在反向信号时平多仓

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否在反向信号时平空仓

parameters.name: InpUsingVolumeWeight
parameters.description: 成交量权重：无/成交量/ tick成交量

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Signal detection bar index (0 = current bar)

pros: 使用新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少不必要的交易
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同交易者的风险偏好
止损止盈设置完整，默认止盈是止损的2倍，具有正期望收益比
买卖方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，策略灵活性高
使用指标平滑和平均处理，减少虚假信号的影响
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trade entries within the same bar, reducing unnecessary transactions
Multiple money management modes provide flexibility to suit different traders' risk preferences
Complete stop loss and take profit configuration with default 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio suggesting positive expectancy
Independent control for buy/sell open and close operations provides high strategy flexibility
Indicator smoothing and averaging reduce the impact of false signals
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过大，在H4周期下可能导致较大回撤
缺乏加仓和减仓逻辑，无法在趋势延续时增加头寸
没有 Spread 过滤机制，在高点差环境下可能不利
依赖自定义BSI指标，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号有效性
信号只基于单一指标，缺乏多维度确认，容易产生假突破
cons_en: StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are very large, potentially causing significant drawdowns on H4 timeframe
No scaling in or out logic, unable to add positions when trends continue
No spread filter mechanism, which may be disadvantageous in high-spread environments
Depends on a custom BSI indicator whose internal logic is opaque, making signal validation difficult
Signals based on a single indicator without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to false breakouts
improvements: 增加多时间周期确认机制，例如在H4信号发出前检查日线趋势方向是否一致
添加动态止损止盈机制，根据ATR或波动率自适应调整，而非固定点数
增加点差过滤和时间过滤（如避开新闻时段和低流动性时段），减少不利成交
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., verify H4 signals align with daily trend direction before entry
Implement dynamic stop loss and take profit based on ATR or volatility instead of fixed point values
Add spread filter and time filter (e.g., avoid news events and low liquidity sessions) to reduce unfavorable fills

risk_points: 止损1000点过大，单笔亏损可能占账户较大比例
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失或更新不兼容会导致EA初始化失败
缺乏最大持仓数限制和账户整体风险控制机制
risk_points_en: 1000-point stop loss is very large, a single losing trade could represent a significant portion of the account
Dependency on external custom indicator - missing or incompatible indicator file causes EA initialization failure
No maximum position limit or account-level risk control mechanism
